title: Weygandt's sergeant responds to UAPGerb's email using his full name

tellings.quote: but one of them, um, I emailed from my uapgrmail.com email.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says that sometime in the 2020s he emailed people connected to a man named Weygandt, using his own UAPGerb email address. He says one of them, a sergeant who had served with Weygandt (he names Sergeant Atkins and Sergeant Allen), wrote back and signed with his full name. He told this on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, as a sign that the people around Weygandt were real and willing to answer.
